verdict.rationale: Fern documents a self-hosted container option that resolves env vars per request (fern-docs-11/31), implying some ability to run docs outside Fern's managed hosting, but there is no evidence of exporting the site as a plain static bundle deployable to arbitrary static hosts (e.g., S3/Netlify) — the container still appears to be Fern's own server-side artifact. Missing for 10: explicit static-export/build command, confirmation the output is a portable static bundle (not just a self-hosted Fern container), and independent verification of hosting elsewhere without ongoing Fern dependency.
